user.title: PSE&G Account Sign-In
user.description:
Choose one of two ways to connect your PSE&G account:

**Option A: Automated Sign-In (Recommended)**
Enter your **Username** and **Password** below, select your MFA delivery method, and leave the Cookie field empty. If a verification code is needed, you will be prompted on the next screen.

**Option B: Direct Session Cookie**
Paste your active browser cookie below (leave Username & Password empty).
*How to get it:* Log into https://mysmartenergy.nj.pseg.com in your browser, open Developer Tools (F12) → Network tab → click any request (e.g. `Dashboard`) → copy the `Cookie` request header.
